articles.title: 2-alarm garage fire in Hamburg draws crews from Berks, Schuylkill
articles.mainIdea: 2-alarm garage fire in Hamburg draws crews from Berks, Schuylkill
articles.summary: Reading Eagle, Pa.: 2-alarm garage fire in Hamburg draws crews from Berks, Schuylkill. A two-alarm garage fire drew fire companies from Berks and Schuylkill counties to Hamburg over the weekend. Crews were dispatched shortly before noon Saturday to the structure fire at North Fourth and Island streets. A Hamburg Fire Company deputy chief established command and reported a downed Met-Ed line that knocked out power to hundreds of customers. Crews put multiple hand lines in service ...
